prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1341; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate pain and swelling in the right knee, with limited weight-bearing on the day of injury. Physical examination revealed effusion, tenderness along the medial joint line, and restricted range of motion with pain on flexion. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury without acute bony abnormality. The working diagnosis was a sprain of the medial collateral ligament with associated internal derangement, managed conservatively.

Treatment consisted of a structured course of physical therapy, including progressive strengthening of the quadriceps and hamstrings, gait training, and manual therapy directed at joint mobility. A hinged knee brace was used during the early phase of recovery. Over the course of 21 visits, the patient demonstrated steady improvement in pain, swelling, and functional tolerance. At discharge, range of motion was near normal, strength was improved, and the patient was ambulating without assistive devices. Residual mild discomfort with prolonged stair use was noted, and a home exercise program was provided.
